product_metadata.title: Zenna Home 7656NN Toilet Paper Reserve, Satin Nickel
features: HOLDS UP TO 4 ROLLS OF TOILET PAPER: Convenient storage of standard or jumbo sized rolls
EASY TO FILL AND REMOVE TOILET PAPER: Open design allows easy access to store and remove toilet paper rolls
COMPACT SIZED TO FIT IN YOUR BATH: Slim design fits into small bathrooms while holding up to 4 rolls
STURDY AND RUST RESISTANT: Metal construction is durable and has a finish that resists rust
ATTRACTIVE ADDITION TO YOUR BATH DECOR: Rich satin nickel finish to complement your bath decor choices
description: Even the smallest bathroom needs to have extra toilet paper on hand, and with its compact design, the Zenna Home Toilet Paper Reserve fits into almost any sized room to keep up to four rolls within reach. The reserve's sturdy metal wire construction with balled feet will keep rolls of stored toilet paper off the floor so they stay dry. Its open front design allows for easy access add or remove rolls. The durable rust-resistant, satin nickel finish looks great in almost any bathroom setting. The toilet paper reserve is ready to use with no assembly required. It measures 17. 25 in. H x 6 in. W x 6 in. D.
